_about: Loop 3h slice 2 (docs/DEMO.md 6.3, checklist F4): the 20 Syrenki, small mermaid figurines by the kerb round the demo's districts (syrenki.gd). Each: `id`, `district` (an id in districts.json; check_syrenki.gd checks the point lies in it), the anchor (`place`: an id in places.json, or `near`: [lat, lon]), `real` (true: the real statue, the Old Town's), `name` and `line` [pl, en] (≤ 70 characters each). The figurine stands on the kerb of the street nearest its anchor; a drive past within `near` metres finds it. `rewards`: what a count of Syrenki found gives once (`paint`: a garage.gd paint id unlocked, `zl`, `respect`) and its card's words. Words written in slice 2 for the game-designer to review.

text: Nowy lakier w garażu: Łuska Syreny.
A new paint in the garage: Mermaid scale.
The city says thanks: 150 zł and respect.
Wszystkie! Srebro Syreny w garażu i 300 zł.
All of them! Mermaid silver in the garage, 300 zł.

name: Syrenka pod Pałacem
The Mermaid by the Palace
line: Pałac jej nie zauważa. Ona jego też nie.
The Palace ignores her. She returns the favour.

name: Syrenka na targu
The market Mermaid
line: Kupiła pietruszkę. Miecz ma na wszelki wypadek.
She bought parsley. The sword is just in case.

name: Syrenka na dworcu
The Mermaid at the station
line: Czeka na pociąg od 1975 roku. Opóźniony.
Waiting for a train since 1975. Delayed.

name: Syrenka przy elektrowni
The Mermaid by the power station
line: Ładuje miecz. Pełna bateria o północy.
Charging her sword. Full battery by midnight.

name: Syrenka na Powiślu
The Powiśle Mermaid
line: Bilet ma, pociągu nie ma. Jest za to piwo.
She has a ticket and no train. There is beer.

name: Syrenka naukowiec
The scientist Mermaid
line: Bada, czemu wszyscy robią sobie z nią selfie.
Researching why everyone takes selfies with her.

name: Syrenka na Rynku
The Mermaid on the Market Square
line: Ta prawdziwa. Brąz, tarcza, miecz, zero cierpliwości.
The real one. Bronze, shield, sword, zero patience.

name: Syrenka na murach
The Mermaid on the walls
line: Pilnuje bramy. Turystów wpuszcza, korków nie.
Guarding the gate. Tourists in, traffic jams out.

name: Syrenka w fontannach
The Mermaid in the fountains
line: Wreszcie woda, która gra. Ona tańczy.
At last, water that plays music. She dances.

name: Syrenka na Nowym Świecie
The Mermaid on Nowy Świat
line: Pączek w jednej ręce, miecz w drugiej.
A doughnut in one hand, the sword in the other.

name: Syrenka na wiadukcie
The Mermaid on the viaduct
line: Tu jeździ się powoli. Ona i tak jest szybsza.
You drive slowly here. She's faster anyway.

name: Syrenka na placu
The Mermaid on the square
line: Trzy krzyże, jedna syrenka. Rachunek się zgadza.
Three crosses, one mermaid. The maths checks out.

name: Syrenka kibic
The Mermaid fan
line: Szalik na ogonie. Gol czy nie, i tak krzyczy.
A scarf on her tail. Goal or no goal, she shouts.

name: Syrenka z Ząbkowskiej
The Mermaid of Ząbkowska
line: Na Pradze bierze miecz nawet po kebaba.
On Praga she takes the sword even for a kebab.

name: Syrenka na plaży
The Mermaid on the beach
line: Wreszcie piasek. Ogon go nie lubi, ona tak.
Sand at last. The tail hates it, she loves it.

name: Syrenka w ogrodzie
The Mermaid in the garden
line: Karmi kaczki. Kaczki udają, że jej nie znają.
Feeding the ducks. They pretend not to know her.

name: Syrenka na zakupach
The Mermaid out shopping
line: Szuka butów. Mały problem: nie ma nóg.
Shopping for shoes. Small problem: no legs.

name: Syrenka w Mordorze
The Mermaid in Mordor
line: Spotkanie o 9:00, potem spotkanie o spotkaniu.
A 9:00 meeting, then a meeting about the meeting.

name: Syrenka na Zbawiciela
The Mermaid on Plac Zbawiciela
line: Matcha, okulary, ogon. Wtapia się w tłum.
Matcha, sunglasses, a tail. She blends right in.

name: Syrenka pod Sejmem
The Mermaid by the Sejm
line: Przyszła na obrady. Wyszła na kawę.
She came for the session. Left for a coffee.
